name: Chris C. Han
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Pasadena, California
about: Mr. Han is a commercial litigation attorney and the founding and managing partner of Han LLP Attorneys at Law in Los Angeles, California. He represents privately held companies, partnerships, private investment funds, and emerging startups in high-stakes business disputes across the greater Los Angeles area. His practice centers on commercial litigation, business disputes, and contract litigation.

Mr. Han is a strategist first. He starts with the client's commercial objective, then builds the shortest path to it — pressing through trial, resolving early to protect a key relationship, or creating the leverage that forces a favorable deal. Clients come to him for straight assessments of risk, cost, and odds, not just legal analysis.

That discipline traces to his earlier career as a quantitative analyst at Corporate Executive Board, where he advised Fortune 100 legal and compliance executives on governance and misconduct risk. The work taught him to read data, anticipate how disputes unfold, and weigh every decision against its long-term cost — an analytical edge he brings to the courtroom and the negotiating table.
Mr. Han measures his work by results. He cuts complex disputes down to the few issues that decide them and runs each case with strategy and budget aligned from the first filing to resolution.

Mr. Han earned a B.A. in psychology from the University of California, Irvine (2005) and a J.D. from Boston University School of Law (2014). He is admitted to practice in California, New York, and Massachusetts, and before the federal courts in each state.
